evidence_plan.requirement: Definition of Random Kitchen Sink approach
Application of Random Kitchen Sink approach
Effectiveness of Random Kitchen Sink approach

payload.reason: The evidence provides a clear definition, application, and effectiveness of the Random Kitchen Sink approach in offensive language detection.

claims.text: The Random Kitchen Sink (RKS) approach maps data vectors to a space where linear separation is possible, providing an approximate kernel function via explicit mapping.
RKS has been applied in natural language processing tasks, specifically for detecting offensive language in social media.
The RKS method achieved a maximum accuracy of 99.53% when using features generated by the Fasttext model, demonstrating its effectiveness.
